editorial:
Ever wondered how a period drama actually comes together? If you love the sweeping landscapes and intense romance of the Poldark series, you will have a blast with this deep dive. It takes you right onto the sets in Cornwall, where you get to see the cast and crew in their natural element. The vibe is very relaxed and welcoming, making you feel like you are hanging out with the actors while they talk about their characters and the challenges of filming in the wind and rain. It is a great way to see the human side of the stars you see on screen.

What really stands out is the focus on the costume design and the hard work that goes into making a fake old town look real. The pacing is steady and easy to follow, though it might feel a bit slow if you aren't already a fan of the show.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing a montage of the best moments from the first season. It ends with the cast reflecting on how much they grew during the shoot and what the show means to them personally. There is no big twist since it is a documentary, but it concludes with a heartwarming look at the friendship between the actors. It leaves you feeling inspired and ready to go back and rewatch the entire series.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Poldark and wants to see how TV magic happens.
